visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white beanie and a white puffer jacket, sits at a blue mahjong table in a room with wood paneling. She draws a tile and reveals a winning hand, looking pleased. (2) Cut to a woman in a grey knitted sweater looking annoyed. A man in a grey hoodie then stands up aggressively at a table with blackboard-style math equations in the background, scattering mahjong tiles in frustration. (3) The girl in the beanie runs through a narrow outdoor alleyway, occasionally looking back. She is pursued by three men in black suits. The setting is an urban residential area with scooters and brick walls. (4) The girl hides behind a metal railing with another woman wearing a tan hoodie. They converse in close-up shots with focused facial expressions. (5) The scene shifts to another mahjong game where the girl, now in a cream sweater, draws a winning tile again. Finally, she walks out of a dark doorway and is stopped by two men in suits.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop BGM starts immediately. Sharp, percussive clacking sounds of mahjong tiles dominate the percussive layer. A young female voice speaks with a playful, higher-pitched tone. (2) A loud, low-frequency thud occurs as a man hits the table. His voice is loud, aggressive, and exhibits high vocal tension/shouting. Rapid-fire shouting and the sound of sliding tiles follow. (3) A fast-tempo electronic synth track swells during a chase sequence. Sounds of rhythmic footsteps on asphalt and heavy breathing are audible. Shouted commands from multiple male voices punctuate the track. (4) The BGM volume drops significantly. Ambient low-frequency room tone is heard. Two female voices engage in a dialogue with moderate speech rate and clear articulation. (5) Mahjong clacking returns over a new upbeat BGM track. A final hard cut features a deep, authoritative male voice with low pitch and high dominance.

It uses a fictional narrative about a woman who keeps winning ('Zumo'), leading to a chase by disgruntled opponents, only to reveal her mysterious luck or skill at the end.
